title: Bayesian Nonparametric Modeling of Latent Partitions via Stirling-Gamma Priors

split.decision: Original frozen generator; full independent 20-replicate K=2,4,6 validation and hidden-test splits, each dataset n=500. Observations only with opaque IDs.

baseline.paper_ref: Section 5.1 / Figure 3; source manifest baseline 0.6568, not measured here.

allowed_changes: Any valid inference or posterior approximation algorithm, proposal, variational family, numerical solver, initialization and convergence strategy may replace the baseline Gibbs implementation.
Auxiliary losses may improve approximation of this same posterior; Monte Carlo length and burn-in are numerical choices.
When retaining the supplied Gibbs transition kernel, changing only niter=15000, burnin=5000, init_type=1 or alpha_init=1 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Approximate the specified Stirling-gamma Dirichlet-process-mixture posterior of occupied cluster count K_n, improving its guarded true-count posterior probability.
The bivariate Gaussian mixture likelihood, DP random measure, alpha ~ Sg(1,0.25,n), and NIW base N(mu;0,Sigma/2) IW(Sigma;2,I) define the fixed posterior.
All 500 observed rows per independent dataset, the normalized K=1..500 output distribution, three cell floors, and equal cell aggregation remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the likelihood, base measure or precision prior, tune them against true K, or submit a generic classification distribution instead of the specified posterior.
No hidden truth, data substitutions, cross-dataset pooling or ID-derived predictions.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
